title: AtlasGB
description: One AtlasGB atlas: every address of one Game Boy cartridge, with the evidence for it. This schema is shared by every atlas in the project and describes atlases/<id>/data/atlas.json, which tools/export.py generates from that atlas's atlas.tsv. Which cartridge a file is about is in its own meta block, never assumed. The prose contract is docs/schema.md.

meta.description: Which cartridge this atlas is about, and counts recomputed from the entries on every export.

atlas.description: The atlas id: its directory name under atlases/.

title.description: The cartridge, in words. A count with no game attached is meaningless.

license.description: SPDX id of the licence over the atlas *content*. It travels in the file because the file gets copied away from the LICENSE files. The tooling that generated it is MIT and is licensed separately.

attribution.description: The credit that satisfies the content licence. Name the atlas and the ref alongside it.

storage_entries.description: Entries in VRAM, SRAM, WRAM0 or HRAM. The published evidence tiers count these, because 'observed live' means something different for a table in the cartridge.

evidence.description: How many storage entries carry each tier.

entries.description: One object per row of the atlas's atlas.tsv, in the same order.

region.description: The CPU address range the entry lives in.

bank.description: Bank number as a decimal string, or '-' where the region is not banked. Only SRAM and ROMX are banked; (region, bank, addr) is the identifying triple.

addr.description: The CPU address, as every other Gen 1 document spells it.

addr_int.description: The same address as an integer, so a tool can index by it without parsing.

len.description: Bytes this entry owns before the next distinct address. A span, not a type width. 0 means an end marker that owns nothing.

symbol.description: The pret/pokered label, unique across the file. gap and free rows carry a synthetic identifier instead.

role.description: entry: the canonical row. alias: another name for the same bytes. instance: slot 2..N of a repeated structure. gap: bytes no label reaches. free: RAM the linker reported EMPTY.

sect.description: The linker section the symbol was declared in, verbatim from the RGBDS map file.

group.description: Our chapter, and the page the entry is rendered onto (docs/<group>.md). Editorial judgement, produced by rules in tools/chapters.py.

verify.description: The evidence for this entry. Empty means no evidence yet — stated, not hidden. Written only by landing a verification report; see docs/verification.md.

desc.description: What it is, in our own words, as Markdown. May be empty.
